# Overview

This document extends **v2** by running **200 macro-replications** (batches), each
containing **200 virtual BE trials**, for every combination of sample size, T/R ratio,
and uncertainty method. This yields **200 independent estimates** of power (or type I
error) per cell, from which we compute:

- **Point estimate**: mean pass rate across the 200 batches
- **95% CI for the true rate**: mean ± 1.96 × SE (SE = sd / √200)
- **Percentile interval**: 2.5th – 97.5th percentile of the 200 batch estimates

All results are presented in two forms:

- **Absolute**: raw power / type I error rate with 95% CI for each method
- **Relative to Fixed**: each uncertainty method (VCOV, Bootstrap, SIR) benchmarked
  against the Fixed (plug-in) method, reported as both an absolute difference
  (percentage points, pp) with 95% CI and a multiplicative ratio with 95% CI

::: {.callout-warning}
## Computational Cost
With 200 batches × 200 trials × 7 sample sizes × 5 T/R ratios × 4 methods =
**5.6 million** individual trial simulations, this document takes significant time
to render. Reduce `N_BATCHES` or `N_SIMS_PER_BATCH` in Section 11 for faster testing.
:::

# Load Libraries
```{julia}
#| output: false
using Pumas
using Random
using Distributions
using LinearAlgebra
using Statistics
using DataFrames
using Bioequivalence
using CairoMakie
using Makie
using Logging
```

# Set Random Seed
```{julia}
#| output: false
Random.seed!(142)
```

# PK Model

`tvbio` controls relative bioavailability of Test vs Reference via `@dosecontrol`,
so AUC_T/AUC_R = tvbio exactly.

```{julia}
#| output: false
pkmodel = @model begin
    @param begin
        tvcl  ∈ RealDomain(lower=0)
        tvv   ∈ RealDomain(lower=0)
        tvka  ∈ RealDomain(lower=0)
        tvbio ∈ RealDomain(lower=0)
        Ω     ∈ PDiagDomain(3)
        σ     ∈ RealDomain(lower=0)
    end

    @random begin
        η ~ MvNormal(Ω)
    end

    @covariates TRT

    @pre begin
        CL  = tvcl * exp(η[1])
        V   = tvv  * exp(η[2])
        Ka  = tvka * exp(η[3])
    end

    @dosecontrol begin
        bioav = (Depot = TRT == "T" ? tvbio : 1.0,)
    end

    @dynamics begin
        Depot'   = -Ka * Depot
        Central' =  Ka * Depot - (CL / V) * Central
    end

    @derived begin
        cp = @. Central / V
        dv ~ @. Normal(cp, σ)
    end
end
```

# True Parameter Values
```{julia}
#| output: false
θ_true = (
    tvcl  = 5.0,
    tvv   = 50.0,
    tvka  = 1.2,
    tvbio = 1.0,
    Ω     = Diagonal([0.09, 0.09, 0.09]),   # ~30% CV IIV
    σ     = 0.2
)
```

# Simulation Helpers
```{julia}
#| output: false
function create_be_population(n_per_arm)
    subjects = Subject[]
    for trt in ["R", "T"], i in 1:n_per_arm
        push!(subjects, Subject(
            id     = length(subjects) + 1,
            events = DosageRegimen(100, time = 0),
            covariates = (TRT = trt,)
        ))
    end
    return Population(subjects)
end

function simulate_be_trial(params; n_per_arm = 30)
    pop = create_be_population(n_per_arm)
    return simobs(pkmodel, pop, params; obstimes = 0:1:72)
end
```

# Simulate Reference Trial and Fit
```{julia}
#| output: false
ref_sim = simulate_be_trial(θ_true; n_per_arm = 30)

sim_pop = read_pumas(
    DataFrame(ref_sim);
    id = :id, time = :time, observations = [:dv],
    amt = :amt, evid = :evid, covariates = [:TRT], cmt = :cmt
)

init = (
    tvcl  = 4.5,
    tvv   = 45.0,
    tvka  = 1.0,
    tvbio = 1.0,
    Ω     = Diagonal([0.1, 0.1, 0.1]),
    σ     = 0.3
)

fit_res = fit(pkmodel, sim_pop, init, Pumas.FOCE())
θ̂ = coef(fit_res)
nothing
```

# Uncertainty Extraction

## Sampling Helper
```{julia}
#| output: false
"""
Sample `n` parameter NamedTuples from a MvNormal on the estimation (log) scale.
"""
function sample_from_vcov(mean_params, V, n)
    μ = [
        log(mean_params.tvcl), log(mean_params.tvv),
        log(mean_params.tvka), log(mean_params.tvbio),
        log(mean_params.Ω[1,1]), log(mean_params.Ω[2,2]), log(mean_params.Ω[3,3]),
        log(mean_params.σ)
    ]
    dist = MvNormal(μ, Symmetric(V))
    return [begin
        s = rand(dist)
        (tvcl  = exp(s[1]), tvv  = exp(s[2]),
         tvka  = exp(s[3]), tvbio = exp(s[4]),
         Ω     = Diagonal([exp(s[5]), exp(s[6]), exp(s[7])]),
         σ     = exp(s[8]))
    end for _ in 1:n]
end
```

## Method 1: VCOV (Asymptotic Normal)
```{julia}
#| output: false
vcov_param_samples = sample_from_vcov(θ̂, vcov(fit_res), 200)
```

## Method 2: Bootstrap
```{julia}
#| output: false
boot_settings = Bootstrap(
    samples = 100,
    stratify_by = nothing,
    ensemblealg = EnsembleThreads()
)
boot_inf = infer(fit_res, boot_settings; level = 0.95)

boot_param_samples = sample_from_vcov(coef(boot_inf), vcov(boot_inf), 200)
nothing
```

## Method 3: SIR
```{julia}
#| output: false
sir_settings = SIR(samples = 200, resamples = 100)
sir_inf = infer(fit_res, sir_settings; level = 0.95)

sir_param_samples = sample_from_vcov(coef(sir_inf), vcov(sir_inf), 200)
nothing
```

# TOST for Parallel-Design BE
```{julia}
#| output: false
"""
Two One-Sided Tests on log-scale data for two independent groups.
Returns GMR, 90% CI bounds, and pass/fail status.
"""
function tost_test_detailed(log_R, log_T; alpha = 0.05, θ_L = 0.80, θ_U = 1.25)
    n_R, n_T = length(log_R), length(log_T)
    (n_R < 2 || n_T < 2) && return (gmr=NaN, ci_lo=NaN, ci_hi=NaN, pass=false)
    Δ   = mean(log_T) - mean(log_R)
    sp² = ((n_R - 1) * var(log_R) + (n_T - 1) * var(log_T)) / (n_R + n_T - 2)
    se  = sqrt(sp² * (1 / n_R + 1 / n_T))
    df  = n_R + n_T - 2
    tc  = quantile(TDist(df), 1 - alpha)
    gmr   = exp(Δ)
    ci_lo = exp(Δ - tc * se)
    ci_hi = exp(Δ + tc * se)
    pass  = ci_lo >= θ_L && ci_hi <= θ_U
    return (gmr=gmr, ci_lo=ci_lo, ci_hi=ci_hi, pass=pass)
end

"""Find first matching column from `candidates` in DataFrame `df`."""
function find_col(df, candidates)
    ns = names(df)
    for c in candidates
        if string(c) in ns
            return Symbol(c)
        end
    end
    error("None of $candidates found in columns: $ns")
end

# Detect AUC and Cmax column names once from the reference NCA table
const AUC_COL  = find_col(nca_tbl_ref, ["aucinf_obs", "aucinf", "auclast", "AUC", "auc"])
const CMAX_COL = find_col(nca_tbl_ref, ["cmax", "Cmax", "CMAX"])
println("Using NCA columns: AUC = $AUC_COL, Cmax = $CMAX_COL")

"""Extract non-missing, positive values from a column as Float64 vector."""
function clean_pk_col(df, col)
    vals = df[!, col]
    return Float64[v for v in vals if !ismissing(v) && v > 0]
end

"""
Run NCA on a simulated trial, then apply TOST to AUC and Cmax.
Returns `nothing` if insufficient data.
"""
function run_be_on_sim_detailed(sim)
    simdf = DataFrame(sim)
    simdf.route .= "ev"
    simdf.dv .= max.(simdf.dv, 0.0)

    tbl = with_logger(NullLogger()) do
        ncapop = read_nca(simdf;
            id = :id, time = :time, amt = :amt,
            observations = :dv, route = :route, group = [:TRT]
        )
        nca_out = run_nca(ncapop)
        nca_out.reportdf
    end

    R = tbl[tbl.TRT .== "R", :]
    T = tbl[tbl.TRT .== "T", :]

    auc_R  = clean_pk_col(R, AUC_COL)
    auc_T  = clean_pk_col(T, AUC_COL)
    cmax_R = clean_pk_col(R, CMAX_COL)
    cmax_T = clean_pk_col(T, CMAX_COL)

    (length(auc_R) < 2 || length(auc_T) < 2)  && return nothing
    (length(cmax_R) < 2 || length(cmax_T) < 2) && return nothing

    auc_res  = tost_test_detailed(log.(auc_R),  log.(auc_T))
    cmax_res = tost_test_detailed(log.(cmax_R), log.(cmax_T))

    return (
        auc_gmr=auc_res.gmr, auc_lo=auc_res.ci_lo, auc_hi=auc_res.ci_hi, auc_pass=auc_res.pass,
        cmax_gmr=cmax_res.gmr, cmax_lo=cmax_res.ci_lo, cmax_hi=cmax_res.ci_hi, cmax_pass=cmax_res.pass,
        overall_pass=auc_res.pass && cmax_res.pass
    )
end
```

# %CV Estimation
```{julia}
#| output: false
"""
Estimate %CV for AUC and Cmax from simulated parallel-design trials.
"""
function estimate_cv(param_samples; n_per_arm=60, n_reps=50)
    auc_vars  = Float64[]
    cmax_vars = Float64[]

    for _ in 1:n_reps
        θ_draw = param_samples[rand(1:length(param_samples))]
        sim_params = merge(θ_draw, (tvbio = 1.0,))

        try
            sim = simulate_be_trial(sim_params; n_per_arm = n_per_arm)
            simdf = DataFrame(sim)
            simdf.route .= "ev"
            simdf.dv .= max.(simdf.dv, 0.0)

            tbl = with_logger(NullLogger()) do
                ncapop = read_nca(simdf;
                    id = :id, time = :time, amt = :amt,
                    observations = :dv, route = :route, group = [:TRT]
                )
                nca_out = run_nca(ncapop)
                nca_out.reportdf
            end

            R = tbl[tbl.TRT .== "R", :]
            T = tbl[tbl.TRT .== "T", :]

            auc_R  = clean_pk_col(R, AUC_COL)
            auc_T  = clean_pk_col(T, AUC_COL)
            cmax_R = clean_pk_col(R, CMAX_COL)
            cmax_T = clean_pk_col(T, CMAX_COL)

            if length(auc_R) >= 2 && length(auc_T) >= 2
                n_r, n_t = length(auc_R), length(auc_T)
                sp² = ((n_r - 1) * var(log.(auc_R)) + (n_t - 1) * var(log.(auc_T))) / (n_r + n_t - 2)
                push!(auc_vars, sp²)
            end
            if length(cmax_R) >= 2 && length(cmax_T) >= 2
                n_r, n_t = length(cmax_R), length(cmax_T)
                sp² = ((n_r - 1) * var(log.(cmax_R)) + (n_t - 1) * var(log.(cmax_T))) / (n_r + n_t - 2)
                push!(cmax_vars, sp²)
            end
        catch
            continue
        end
    end

    auc_cv  = 100 * sqrt(exp(mean(auc_vars)) - 1)
    cmax_cv = 100 * sqrt(exp(mean(cmax_vars)) - 1)
    return (auc_cv=auc_cv, cmax_cv=cmax_cv)
end
```

```{julia}
#| output: false
fixed_param_samples = fill(θ̂, 100)
cv_estimates = estimate_cv(fixed_param_samples; n_per_arm = 60, n_reps = 100)
nothing
```

```{julia}
#| echo: false

println("Cmax %CV = $(round(cv_estimates.cmax_cv, digits=1))%")
```

# Simulation Configuration

Adjust `N_BATCHES` and `N_SIMS_PER_BATCH` for faster testing
(e.g., 10 batches × 50 trials).

```{julia}
#| output: false
const SAMPLE_SIZES     = [12, 24, 30, 40, 50, 60, 80]
const TR_RATIOS        = [0.7, 0.9, 1.0, 1.1, 1.3]
const N_BATCHES        = 200   # macro-replications
const N_SIMS_PER_BATCH = 200   # trials per macro-replication
```

# Batch Simulation Engine

For each (sample size, T/R ratio) cell, we run `N_BATCHES` independent batches of
`N_SIMS_PER_BATCH` trials. Each batch yields one pass-rate estimate. The collection of
200 batch pass-rates is then summarized into a point estimate and CI.

```{julia}
#| output: false
#| code-summary: "Batch simulation engine (click to expand)"

"""
Run batched virtual BE simulations. Returns a DataFrame with one row per
(method, tr_ratio, n_per_arm, batch_id).
"""
function virtual_be_sim_batched(param_samples, method_name;
                                tr_ratios  = TR_RATIOS,
                                n_per_arms = SAMPLE_SIZES,
                                n_batches  = N_BATCHES,
                                n_sims     = N_SIMS_PER_BATCH)

    batch_results = DataFrame(
        method    = String[],
        tr_ratio  = Float64[],
        n_per_arm = Int[],
        batch_id  = Int[],
        n_pass    = Int[],
        n_valid   = Int[],
        pass_rate = Float64[]
    )

    total_cells = length(n_per_arms) * length(tr_ratios)
    cell_count  = 0

    for n_arm in n_per_arms, tr in tr_ratios
        cell_count += 1

        for b in 1:n_batches
            n_pass  = 0
            n_error = 0

            for i in 1:n_sims
                θ_draw     = param_samples[rand(1:length(param_samples))]
                sim_params = merge(θ_draw, (tvbio = tr,))

                try
                    sim = simulate_be_trial(sim_params; n_per_arm = n_arm)
                    res = run_be_on_sim_detailed(sim)
                    if res === nothing
                        n_error += 1
                    else
                        res.overall_pass && (n_pass += 1)
                    end
                catch
                    n_error += 1
                end
            end

            n_valid = n_sims - n_error
            rate    = n_valid > 0 ? (n_pass / n_valid) * 100 : NaN

            push!(batch_results, (
                method    = method_name,
                tr_ratio  = tr,
                n_per_arm = n_arm,
                batch_id  = b,
                n_pass    = n_pass,
                n_valid   = n_valid,
                pass_rate = rate
            ))
        end

        println("  [$method_name] ($cell_count/$total_cells) n=$n_arm, T/R=$tr — $n_batches batches done")
    end

    return batch_results
end

"""
Aggregate batch-level results into point estimates with CIs.
Returns a DataFrame with one row per (method, tr_ratio, n_per_arm).
"""
function summarize_batches(batch_df)
    summary = combine(groupby(batch_df, [:method, :tr_ratio, :n_per_arm]),
        :pass_rate => mean   => :mean_rate,
        :pass_rate => std    => :std_rate,
        :pass_rate => length => :n_batches,
        :pass_rate => (x -> quantile(x, 0.025)) => :pctl_025,
        :pass_rate => (x -> quantile(x, 0.975)) => :pctl_975
    )
    # 95% CI for the true rate (SE-based)
    summary.se    = summary.std_rate ./ sqrt.(summary.n_batches)
    summary.ci_lo = max.(summary.mean_rate .- 1.96 .* summary.se, 0.0)
    summary.ci_hi = min.(summary.mean_rate .+ 1.96 .* summary.se, 100.0)
    return summary
end
```

# Run All Methods

```{julia}
#| output: false

println("Running Fixed method...")
batches_fixed = virtual_be_sim_batched(fixed_param_samples, "Fixed")

println("Running VCOV method...")
batches_vcov  = virtual_be_sim_batched(vcov_param_samples,  "VCOV")

println("Running Bootstrap method...")
batches_boot  = virtual_be_sim_batched(boot_param_samples,  "Bootstrap")

println("Running SIR method...")
batches_sir   = virtual_be_sim_batched(sir_param_samples,   "SIR")

# Combine all batch-level results
all_batches = vcat(batches_fixed, batches_vcov, batches_boot, batches_sir)

# Aggregate into summaries with CIs
all_summary = summarize_batches(all_batches)

# ── Relative-to-Fixed computation ──
# Extract Fixed as the reference method
fixed_ref = select(
    filter(r -> r.method == "Fixed", all_summary),
    :tr_ratio, :n_per_arm,
    :mean_rate => :fixed_mean,
    :se        => :fixed_se
)

# Join every non-Fixed method with Fixed's reference values
relative_df = innerjoin(
    filter(r -> r.method != "Fixed", all_summary),
    fixed_ref,
    on = [:tr_ratio, :n_per_arm]
)

# Absolute difference (pp): method − Fixed
relative_df.abs_diff       = relative_df.mean_rate .- relative_df.fixed_mean
relative_df.abs_diff_se    = sqrt.(relative_df.se.^2 .+ relative_df.fixed_se.^2)
relative_df.abs_diff_ci_lo = relative_df.abs_diff .- 1.96 .* relative_df.abs_diff_se
relative_df.abs_diff_ci_hi = relative_df.abs_diff .+ 1.96 .* relative_df.abs_diff_se

# Ratio: method / Fixed  (delta-method SE)
relative_df.ratio = relative_df.mean_rate ./ max.(relative_df.fixed_mean, 1e-10)
relative_df.ratio_se = relative_df.ratio .* sqrt.(
    (relative_df.se ./ max.(relative_df.mean_rate, 1e-10)).^2 .+
    (relative_df.fixed_se ./ max.(relative_df.fixed_mean, 1e-10)).^2
)
relative_df.ratio_ci_lo = relative_df.ratio .- 1.96 .* relative_df.ratio_se
relative_df.ratio_ci_hi = relative_df.ratio .+ 1.96 .* relative_df.ratio_se

# Guard: set ratio columns to NaN where Fixed rate ≈ 0
for col in [:ratio, :ratio_se, :ratio_ci_lo, :ratio_ci_hi]
    relative_df[!, col] = ifelse.(relative_df.fixed_mean .< 0.1, NaN, relative_df[!, col])
end
nothing
```

# Results

## Formatting Helper
```{julia}
#| output: false
fmt_ci(m, lo, hi) = "$(round(m, digits=1)) [$(round(lo, digits=1)), $(round(hi, digits=1))]"

function fmt_diff(d, lo, hi)
    s = round(d, digits=1) >= 0 ? "+" : ""
    "$(s)$(round(d, digits=1)) [$(round(lo, digits=1)), $(round(hi, digits=1))]"
end

function fmt_ratio(r, lo, hi)
    isnan(r) && return "—"
    "$(round(r, digits=3)) [$(round(lo, digits=3)), $(round(hi, digits=3))]"
end
```

# Results — Relative to Fixed

All tables below show VCOV, Bootstrap, and SIR benchmarked against the Fixed (plug-in)
method. The Fixed column shows the absolute reference value for context.

## Difference from Fixed (pp) — Power at T/R = 1.0

```{julia}
#| echo: false
sub_diff = filter(r -> r.tr_ratio == 1.0, relative_df)
sub_diff_disp = copy(sub_diff)
sub_diff_disp.display = fmt_diff.(sub_diff_disp.abs_diff, sub_diff_disp.abs_diff_ci_lo, sub_diff_disp.abs_diff_ci_hi)
diff_wide = unstack(select(sub_diff_disp, :n_per_arm, :method, :display), :n_per_arm, :method, :display)

# Add Fixed reference column
fixed_abs = filter(r -> r.method == "Fixed" && r.tr_ratio == 1.0, all_summary)
fixed_abs_disp = DataFrame(n_per_arm = fixed_abs.n_per_arm,
    Fixed_ref = fmt_ci.(fixed_abs.mean_rate, fixed_abs.ci_lo, fixed_abs.ci_hi))
display(innerjoin(fixed_abs_disp, diff_wide, on = :n_per_arm))
```

```{julia}
diff09 = unstack(select(sub09, :n_per_arm, :method, :display), :n_per_arm, :method, :display)
fixed09 = filter(r -> r.method == "Fixed" && r.tr_ratio == 0.9, all_summary)
fixed09d = DataFrame(n_per_arm = fixed09.n_per_arm,
    Fixed_ref = fmt_ci.(fixed09.mean_rate, fixed09.ci_lo, fixed09.ci_hi))
display(innerjoin(fixed09d, diff09, on = :n_per_arm))
```

# Visualization: Pass Rate Curves with CI Bands
```{julia}
#| label: fig-passrate-ci-bands
#| fig-cap: "BE pass rate (± 95% CI band) across T/R ratios and sample sizes for each uncertainty method."
fig1 = Figure(size = (1400, 900))
methods_list = ["Fixed", "VCOV", "Bootstrap", "SIR"]
size_colors  = [:indigo, :dodgerblue, :steelblue, :seagreen, :orange, :crimson, :darkred]

for (idx, m) in enumerate(methods_list)
    row = (idx - 1) ÷ 2 + 1
    col = (idx - 1) % 2 + 1
    ax = Axis(fig1[row, col];
        xlabel = "T/R Ratio",
        ylabel = "BE Pass Rate (%)",
        title  = "$m Method",
        xticks = TR_RATIOS,
        yticks = 0:10:100
    )

    sub = filter(r -> r.method == m, all_summary)
    for (j, n) in enumerate(SAMPLE_SIZES)
        sub_n = sort(filter(r -> r.n_per_arm == n, sub), :tr_ratio)
        nrow(sub_n) == 0 && continue

        # CI band
        band!(ax, sub_n.tr_ratio, sub_n.ci_lo, sub_n.ci_hi;
            color = (size_colors[j], 0.15))

        # Mean line
        scatterlines!(ax, sub_n.tr_ratio, sub_n.mean_rate;
            label     = "n=$n",
            color     = size_colors[j],
            marker    = :circle,
            markersize = 7,
            linewidth = 2
        )
    end

    hlines!(ax, [5.0]; color = :red, linestyle = :dash, linewidth = 1, label = "5% α")
    vlines!(ax, [0.80, 1.25]; color = :gray70, linestyle = :dot, linewidth = 1)

    if idx == 2
        axislegend(ax; position = :rt, labelsize = 9)
    end
end

Label(fig1[0, :], "BE Pass Rate by T/R Ratio and Sample Size (Mean ± 95% CI)"; fontsize = 20)
fig1
```

# Visualization: Power at T/R = 1.0 with Error Bars
```{julia}
#| label: fig-power-errorbars
#| fig-cap: "Statistical power at T/R = 1.0 by sample size, with 95% CI error bars."
fig2 = Figure(size = (1000, 600))
ax2 = Axis(fig2[1, 1];
    xlabel = "Subjects per Arm",
    ylabel = "Power (%)",
    title  = "Power at T/R = 1.0 (200 Batches × 200 Trials)",
    xticks = SAMPLE_SIZES,
    yticks = 0:10:100
)

method_colors = [:steelblue, :crimson, :seagreen, :darkorange]
method_shapes = [:circle, :diamond, :utriangle, :rect]
method_offsets = [-1.5, -0.5, 0.5, 1.5]  # slight x-offset to avoid overlap

for (i, m) in enumerate(methods_list)
    sub = sort(filter(r -> r.method == m && r.tr_ratio == 1.0, all_summary), :n_per_arm)
    nrow(sub) == 0 && continue
    x_shifted = sub.n_per_arm .+ method_offsets[i]

    errorbars!(ax2, x_shifted, sub.mean_rate,
        sub.mean_rate .- sub.ci_lo, sub.ci_hi .- sub.mean_rate;
        color = method_colors[i], linewidth = 1.5, whiskerwidth = 8)

    scatterlines!(ax2, x_shifted, sub.mean_rate;
        label      = m,
        color      = method_colors[i],
        marker     = method_shapes[i],
        markersize = 12,
        linewidth  = 2
    )
end

hlines!(ax2, [80.0]; color = :gray, linestyle = :dash, linewidth = 1, label = "80% target")
axislegend(ax2; position = :rb)
fig2
```

```{julia}
#| label: fig-forest-power

# Build labels and collect data
forest_sub = sort(filter(r -> r.tr_ratio == 1.0, all_summary), [:method, :n_per_arm])

    sub_m = sort(filter(r -> r.method == m, forest_sub), :n_per_arm)
    for r in eachrow(sub_m)
        row_idx += 1
        push!(y_ticks, "$(r.method), n=$(r.n_per_arm)")

        direction = :x, color = mc, linewidth = 2, whiskerwidth = 6)
    scatter!(ax6, [r.mean_rate], [y];
        color = mc, markersize = 10, marker = :circle)
end
```

# Visualization: Heatmap of Mean Pass Rates
```{julia}
#| label: fig-heatmaps
#| fig-cap: "Heatmap of mean BE pass rates (with CI width annotation) by sample size and T/R ratio."
fig7 = Figure(size = (1400, 900))

for (idx, m) in enumerate(methods_list)
    row = (idx - 1) ÷ 2 + 1
    col = (idx - 1) % 2 + 1

    sub = filter(r -> r.method == m, all_summary)
    mat_mean = zeros(length(SAMPLE_SIZES), length(TR_RATIOS))
    mat_ci   = zeros(length(SAMPLE_SIZES), length(TR_RATIOS))

    for (i, n) in enumerate(SAMPLE_SIZES), (j, tr) in enumerate(TR_RATIOS)
        r = filter(r -> r.n_per_arm == n && r.tr_ratio == tr, sub)
        if nrow(r) > 0
            mat_mean[i, j] = r.mean_rate[1]
            mat_ci[i, j]   = r.ci_hi[1] - r.ci_lo[1]
        else
            mat_mean[i, j] = NaN
            mat_ci[i, j]   = NaN
        end
    end

    ax = Axis(fig7[row, col];
        xlabel = "T/R Ratio",
        ylabel = "Subjects per Arm",
        title  = "$m Method",
        xticks = (1:length(TR_RATIOS), string.(TR_RATIOS)),
        yticks = (1:length(SAMPLE_SIZES), string.(SAMPLE_SIZES))
    )

    hm = heatmap!(ax, 1:length(TR_RATIOS), 1:length(SAMPLE_SIZES), mat_mean';
        colormap = :RdYlGn, colorrange = (0, 100)
    )

    # Annotate with "mean% ± ci_width"
    for (i, n) in enumerate(SAMPLE_SIZES), (j, tr) in enumerate(TR_RATIOS)
        mn = mat_mean[i, j]
        cw = mat_ci[i, j]
        txt = isnan(mn) ? "—" : "$(round(Int, mn))% ±$(round(cw, digits=1))"
        text!(ax, j, i; text = txt, align = (:center, :center),
            fontsize = 9, color = mn > 50 ? :black : :white)
    end

    if idx == 2
        Colorbar(fig7[row, col + 1], hm; label = "Mean Pass Rate (%)")
    end
end

Label(fig7[0, :], "BE Pass Rate Heatmap: Mean ± CI Width"; fontsize = 20)
fig7
```

# Visualization: CI Width vs Sample Size

How the precision of the power estimate improves with sample size:

```{julia}
#| label: fig-ci-width-by-n
#| fig-cap: "Width of the 95% CI for power/type I error as a function of sample size."
fig8 = Figure(size = (1200, 550))

for (pidx, tr_val, title_str) in [(1, 1.0, "Power CI Width (T/R = 1.0)"),
                                    (2, 0.7, "Type I Error CI Width (T/R = 0.7)")]
    ax = Axis(fig8[1, pidx];
        xlabel = "Subjects per Arm",
        ylabel = "95% CI Width (pp)",
        title  = title_str,
        xticks = SAMPLE_SIZES
    )

    for (i, m) in enumerate(methods_list)
        sub = sort(filter(r -> r.method == m && r.tr_ratio == tr_val, all_summary), :n_per_arm)
        nrow(sub) == 0 && continue
        ci_widths = sub.ci_hi .- sub.ci_lo

        scatterlines!(ax, sub.n_per_arm, ci_widths;
            label      = m,
            color      = method_colors[i],
            marker     = method_shapes[i],
            markersize = 10,
            linewidth  = 2
        )
    end

    if pidx == 1
        axislegend(ax; position = :rt, labelsize = 9)
    end
end

Label(fig8[0, :], "Precision of Estimated Operating Characteristics"; fontsize = 18)
fig8
```

# Visualization: Absolute Difference from Fixed (pp)

Power (T/R = 1.0) and Type I Error (T/R = 0.7) — how much each uncertainty
method's estimate deviates from the Fixed plug-in baseline, in percentage points:

```{julia}
#| label: fig-diff-from-fixed
#| fig-cap: "Absolute difference (pp) from Fixed method, with 95% CI. Zero = no difference."
rel_methods = ["VCOV", "Bootstrap", "SIR"]
rel_colors  = [:crimson, :seagreen, :darkorange]
rel_shapes  = [:diamond, :utriangle, :rect]
rel_offsets = [-1.0, 0.0, 1.0]

fig_d1 = Figure(size = (1200, 550))

for (pidx, tr_val, ylab, title_str) in [
        (1, 1.0, "Δ Power (pp)", "Power Difference (T/R = 1.0)"),
        (2, 0.7, "Δ Type I Error (pp)", "Type I Error Difference (T/R = 0.7)")]

    ax = Axis(fig_d1[1, pidx];
        xlabel = "Subjects per Arm",
        ylabel = ylab,
        title  = title_str,
        xticks = SAMPLE_SIZES
    )

    for (i, m) in enumerate(rel_methods)
        sub = sort(filter(r -> r.method == m && r.tr_ratio == tr_val, relative_df), :n_per_arm)
        nrow(sub) == 0 && continue
        x_shifted = sub.n_per_arm .+ rel_offsets[i]

        errorbars!(ax, x_shifted, sub.abs_diff,
            sub.abs_diff .- sub.abs_diff_ci_lo, sub.abs_diff_ci_hi .- sub.abs_diff;
            color = rel_colors[i], linewidth = 1.5, whiskerwidth = 8)

        scatterlines!(ax, x_shifted, sub.abs_diff;
            label      = m,
            color      = rel_colors[i],
            marker     = rel_shapes[i],
            markersize = 10,
            linewidth  = 2
        )
    end

    hlines!(ax, [0.0]; color = :black, linestyle = :dash, linewidth = 1, label = "Fixed (ref)")
    if pidx == 1
        axislegend(ax; position = :rb, labelsize = 9)
    end
end

Label(fig_d1[0, :], "Difference from Fixed Method (pp, Mean ± 95% CI)"; fontsize = 18)
fig_d1
```

# Visualization: Absolute Difference — All T/R Ratios

```{julia}
#| label: fig-diff-all-tr

fig_d1b = Figure(size = (1400, 500))

for (idx, m) in enumerate(rel_methods)
    ax = Axis(fig_d1b[1, idx];
        xlabel = "T/R Ratio",
        ylabel = idx == 1 ? "Δ Pass Rate (pp)" : "",
        title  = "$m − Fixed",
        xticks = TR_RATIOS,
    )

    for (j, n) in enumerate(SAMPLE_SIZES)
        sub_n = sort(filter(r -> r.n_per_arm == n, sub), :tr_ratio)
        nrow(sub_n) == 0 && continue

        band!(ax, sub_n.tr_ratio, sub_n.abs_diff_ci_lo, sub_n.abs_diff_ci_hi;
            color = (size_colors[j], 0.15))
        scatterlines!(ax, sub_n.tr_ratio, sub_n.abs_diff;
            label     = "n=$n",
            color     = size_colors[j],
            marker    = :circle,
            markersize = 6,
            linewidth = 1.5
        )
    end

    hlines!(ax, [0.0]; color = :black, linestyle = :dash, linewidth = 1)
    if idx == 3
        axislegend(ax; position = :rt, labelsize = 8)
```

# Visualization: Ratio to Fixed

Ratio > 1 means the method yields a higher rate than Fixed; < 1 means lower.

```{julia}
#| label: fig-ratio-to-fixed
#| fig-cap: "Ratio of pass rate to Fixed method, with 95% CI. Unity = identical to Fixed."
fig_r1 = Figure(size = (1200, 550))

for (pidx, tr_val, ylab, title_str) in [
        (1, 1.0, "Power Ratio", "Power Ratio (T/R = 1.0)"),
        (2, 0.7, "T1E Ratio", "Type I Error Ratio (T/R = 0.7)")]

    ax = Axis(fig_r1[1, pidx];
        xlabel = "Subjects per Arm",
        ylabel = ylab,
        title  = title_str,
        xticks = SAMPLE_SIZES
    )

    for (i, m) in enumerate(rel_methods)
        sub = sort(filter(r -> r.method == m && r.tr_ratio == tr_val, relative_df), :n_per_arm)
        nrow(sub) == 0 && continue
        # Skip NaN rows
        valid = .!isnan.(sub.ratio)
        sub_v = sub[valid, :]
        nrow(sub_v) == 0 && continue
        x_shifted = sub_v.n_per_arm .+ rel_offsets[i]

        errorbars!(ax, x_shifted, sub_v.ratio,
            sub_v.ratio .- sub_v.ratio_ci_lo, sub_v.ratio_ci_hi .- sub_v.ratio;
            color = rel_colors[i], linewidth = 1.5, whiskerwidth = 8)

        scatterlines!(ax, x_shifted, sub_v.ratio;
            label      = m,
            color      = rel_colors[i],
            marker     = rel_shapes[i],
            markersize = 10,
            linewidth  = 2
        )
    end

    hlines!(ax, [1.0]; color = :black, linestyle = :dash, linewidth = 1, label = "Fixed (ref)")
    if pidx == 1
        axislegend(ax; position = :rb, labelsize = 9)
    end
end

Label(fig_r1[0, :], "Ratio to Fixed Method (Mean ± 95% CI)"; fontsize = 18)
```

# Visualization: Grouped Bar Chart — Difference from Fixed at n = 30

```{julia}
#| label: fig-diff-bars-n30

fig_db = Figure(size = (1200, 600))
ax_db = Axis(fig_db[1, 1];
    xlabel = "T/R Ratio",
    ylabel = "Δ Pass Rate vs Fixed (pp)",
    title  = "Difference from Fixed at n = 30 per Arm (Mean ± 95% CI)",
    xticks = (1:length(TR_RATIOS), string.(TR_RATIOS))
)

n_rel = length(rel_methods)
bw_rel = 0.8 / n_rel
off_rel = [(i - (n_rel + 1) / 2) * bw_rel for i in 1:n_rel]

for (i, m) in enumerate(rel_methods)
    sub = sort(filter(r -> r.method == m && r.n_per_arm == 30, relative_df), :tr_ratio)
    nrow(sub) == 0 && continue
    x_pos = (1:nrow(sub)) .+ off_rel[i]

    barplot!(ax_db, x_pos, sub.abs_diff;
        width = bw_rel * 0.9,
        color = (rel_colors[i], 0.8),
        label = m
    )
    errorbars!(ax_db, x_pos, sub.abs_diff,
        sub.abs_diff .- sub.abs_diff_ci_lo, sub.abs_diff_ci_hi .- sub.abs_diff;
        color = :black, linewidth = 1, whiskerwidth = 4)
```

# Visualization: Forest Plot — Differences at T/R = 1.0
```{julia}
#| label: fig-forest-diff

fig_fd = Figure(size = (900, 800))
ax_fd = Axis(fig_fd[1, 1];
    xlabel = "Δ Power vs Fixed (pp)",
    title  = "Forest Plot — Power Difference from Fixed (T/R = 1.0)"
)

forest_diff = sort(filter(r -> r.tr_ratio == 1.0, relative_df), [:method, :n_per_arm])
n_fd = nrow(forest_diff)
y_fd = collect(n_fd:-1:1)
y_fd_labels = ["$(r.method), n=$(r.n_per_arm)" for r in eachrow(forest_diff)]

ax_fd.yticks = (y_fd, y_fd_labels)
ax_fd.yticklabelsize = 10

for (i, r) in enumerate(eachrow(forest_diff))
    y = y_fd[i]
    mc = rel_colors[findfirst(==(r.method), rel_methods)]
    errorbars!(ax_fd, [r.abs_diff], [y],
        [r.abs_diff - r.abs_diff_ci_lo], [r.abs_diff_ci_hi - r.abs_diff];
        direction = :x, color = mc, linewidth = 2, whiskerwidth = 6)
    scatter!(ax_fd, [r.abs_diff], [y];
        color = mc, markersize = 10, marker = :circle)
end

vlines!(ax_fd, [0.0]; color = :black, linestyle = :dash, linewidth = 1.5)
```

# Visualization: Ratio Heatmap — Method / Fixed

```{julia}
#| label: fig-ratio-heatmap
#| fig-cap: "Heatmap of ratio to Fixed (method / Fixed) by sample size and T/R ratio."
fig_rh = Figure(size = (1400, 500))

for (idx, m) in enumerate(rel_methods)
    sub = filter(r -> r.method == m, relative_df)
    mat_ratio = fill(NaN, length(SAMPLE_SIZES), length(TR_RATIOS))

    for (i, n) in enumerate(SAMPLE_SIZES), (j, tr) in enumerate(TR_RATIOS)
        r = filter(r -> r.n_per_arm == n && r.tr_ratio == tr, sub)
        if nrow(r) > 0 && !isnan(r.ratio[1])
            mat_ratio[i, j] = r.ratio[1]
        end
    end

    ax = Axis(fig_rh[1, idx];
        xlabel = "T/R Ratio",
        ylabel = idx == 1 ? "Subjects per Arm" : "",
        title  = "$m / Fixed",
        xticks = (1:length(TR_RATIOS), string.(TR_RATIOS)),
        yticks = (1:length(SAMPLE_SIZES), string.(SAMPLE_SIZES))
    )

    hm = heatmap!(ax, 1:length(TR_RATIOS), 1:length(SAMPLE_SIZES), mat_ratio';
        colormap = :RdBu, colorrange = (0.8, 1.2)
    )

    for (i, n) in enumerate(SAMPLE_SIZES), (j, tr) in enumerate(TR_RATIOS)
        val = mat_ratio[i, j]
        txt = isnan(val) ? "—" : "$(round(val, digits=2))"
        text!(ax, j, i; text = txt, align = (:center, :center),
            fontsize = 9, color = abs(val - 1.0) < 0.1 ? :black : :white)
    end

    if idx == 3
        Colorbar(fig_rh[1, idx + 1], hm; label = "Ratio (method / Fixed)")
    end
end

Label(fig_rh[0, :], "Ratio to Fixed Method — Heatmap"; fontsize = 18)
fig_rh
```
